# R CMD check NOTEs that are environmental rather than defects.
# One regex per line. Anything not matched here fails the nightly.
#
# Adding a line here is a claim that the NOTE cannot be fixed in the package.
# Say why, in a comment, so the claim can be argued with later.

# CI runners frequently cannot reach the worldclockapi service used to verify
# the build clock. Nothing to do with this package.
unable to verify current time

# A fresh git checkout can carry mtimes a few seconds ahead of the runner clock.
checking for future file timestamps

# 'devel' builds routinely lack binaries for suggested packages on the day the
# nightly runs; the strict job installs them explicitly and is the real gate.
Packages? suggested but not available for checking

# The HTML manual needs a full LaTeX install that the runners do not carry.
# --no-manual is passed for the same reason.
checking (PDF|HTML) version of manual
